General Instructions

Please read the instructions carefully before starting the exam.

General Details:

  • Total Duration: 1 Hour 30 Minutes (90 Minutes).
  • Total Questions: 80 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • Marking Scheme: +1 mark for each correct answer. There is no negative marking for this mock practice.

Color Coding Legend for Questions:

Not Visited: You have not visited the question yet.
Not Answered: You have visited but not answered the question.
Answered: You have answered the question.
Marked for Review: You have marked the question for review.
Answered & Marked: Question answered and also marked for review (will be considered for evaluation).

Navigating to a Question:

  1. Click on the question number in the Question Palette at the left of your screen to go to that question directly.
  2. Click on Save & Next to save your answer for the current question and go to the next question.
  3. Click on Clear Response to clear your chosen option.
  4. Use the Mark for Review button to flag questions you want to check later.
